question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.**
solution: The correct answer is: **strengthening ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Strengthening**" means to make something stronger or more resilient. (किसी चीज़ को अधिक मजबूत या अधिक लचीला बनाना) • **For example**: *Regular exercise is crucial for strengthening your muscles and bones.* • The word "strengthening" accurately conveys the idea of enhancing water resources and infrastructure, aligning with the goals of the 'Jal Shakti' vision. • It is the most appropriate because it fits logically with the blank space and the context of the sentence. Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "**Holding**" means grasping or keeping something securely in place that does not make sense in the given context. (किसी चीज़ को सुरक्षित रूप से पकड़ना या रखना) • "**Proceeding**" means continuing or advancing forward that does not fit with the sentence structure or context. (जारी रखना या आगे बढ़ना) • "**Moving**" means changing position or location, typically from one place to another that does not make sense in the given context. (स्थिति या स्थान बदलना, आमतौर पर एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान पर) 1c8:T81d, The correct answer is: **Immense**
